reviewContext.toolConstraintNote: This review session's tool set did not include a Bash/shell execution tool -- only Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob were available. `git diff`, `git log`, and `node --test` could NOT be executed directly by this adversary. All findings below are grounded in full-file reads of the actual runtime/loop/*.mjs source and *.test.mjs test files (line-cited), plus repo-wide Grep sweeps used as a substitute for `git diff --stat`/`grep -r` scope checks. Builder-reported test counts (265/265, evidence/green-phase.md) were NOT independently re-executed; they are treated as a claim, not verified fact, and are called out explicitly wherever relied upon.

evidence.description: 23 spawn-based integration tests reviewed line-by-line and cross-mapped against every row (1-12) of behavioral-spec.md sec2.5's attempt-state transition matrix -- rows 1-12 are all present and each asserts the correct think()-call count, terminal kind, and (where applicable) the real outbound tool-enum exclusion. This part of edge-case coverage is genuinely strong; the dimension fails solely on REQ-512's untested go-live acceptance criterion (FIND-002), not on the transition-matrix coverage.

runAlwaysActWake() traced line-by-line against REQ-505/506/508/511/513 and behavioral-spec.md sec2.5's 12-row matrix: attemptsUsed is the sole branch arbiter (never currentOfferedSlots identity, matching the FIND-301 fix); the reroute filter correctly hard-excludes the just-picked slot AND every risk:"capital" slot (isMarketRiskFree); the classify call-site at line 747 correctly uses isEarnActionSlot (not isEarnSlot) only inside runAlwaysActWake, leaving the non-engaged path (line 594) on the original isEarnSlot -- REQ-506/FIND-002 widening confirmed correct. REQ-513's dispatch rejection (isRejectableSleepOrOffMenu against the per-attempt currentOfferedSlots, never the static ctx.alwaysActMenu once a reroute is in flight) is correctly wired at lines 710-721 and 780-793. The one confirmed defect is FIND-001 (wrong/missing kind value for the empty-menu terminal case).

REQ-501 identity+flag gate (checkAlwaysActIdentity/resolveAlwaysActGate) traced against the sol-trade/run.sh:28-41 idiom it mirrors: envWithoutSolanaKey strips ANICCA_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY before EITHER derivation (closes the ambient-override bypass sol-trade's own FIND-001 fix addressed), the A-B-A re-confirmation guards a TOCTOU race, and the flag check is a strict `flagRaw === '1'` fail-closed comparison. Confirmed FAIL-CLOSED and non-weakening.

Pure Core module reviewed in full: no I/O imports (fs/http/child_process), every classifier injected, functions small (largest ~25 lines) and single-purpose, names match the spec's own vocabulary (isEarnActionSlot, isMarketRiskFree, nextRerouteState, etc.), no dead code paths found.

runAlwaysActWake is a new, clearly-separated function rather than a tangle of conditionals inside runOneWake -- a reasonable structural choice. Noted (non-blocking, not filed as a finding): the loop-detect bookkeeping block (avoidSlot/loopDetectStreak/recentActions windowing) is duplicated near-verbatim between runOneWake's step 8 (lines 562-570) and runAlwaysActWake's Case C (lines 725-729) -- Phase 2c's own refactor pass extracted only the wake_error helper, not this second duplication. This is a DRY opportunity, not a defect: both copies are currently behaviorally identical and the duplication does not affect correctness.

Purity boundary confirmed intact: the Pure Core module has zero side effects, matching verification-architecture.md's Purity Boundary Map. All Tier-1 pure-function proof obligations (PROP-502a/b/c, 503a, 504a, 505a-shape, 506a/b/e-shape, 507a-shape, 510a, 511a, 512b) are traceable to real, small, testable pure functions.

convergenceSignals.note: This is a Phase-3-style implementation review against behavioral-spec.md REQ-501..REQ-513 directly -- no contracts/sprint-1.md CRIT-* file exists in this worktree for this feature (confirmed via Glob: 'features/franklin-alwaysact-skill-router/contracts/**' returns no files), despite state.json declaring mode:'strict' and the feature's own Embedded VCSDD Task List (behavioral-spec.md sec6, item 7) requiring 'Sprint contract (strict mode) — write contracts/sprint-1.md mapping CRIT-* to REQ-501..REQ-513 before Phase 3 adversarial review.' evaluatedCriteria is empty because there is no approved CRIT-* set to enumerate; this is a process-sequencing gap independent of the two blocking findings above and should be resolved (either the contract authored, or the mode reconciled to lean) before any further Phase 3 iteration is spawned.
